title: Crane Sheds in Pakistan | Steel Mind Engineers
description: Steel crane sheds built for heavy overhead cranes. Steel Mind Engineers built a 96,600 sq ft crane shed at Raiwind. See how crane sheds are designed.
h1: Crane Sheds in Pakistan: Steel Sheds Built for Heavy Overhead Cranes
quickAnswer: A crane shed is a steel building with overhead cranes on rails along its length. Steel Mind Engineers built a 96,600 square foot crane shed and a 97,888 square foot crane and mezzanine shed for Haier at Raiwind.
alt: Steel crane shed under construction with overhead crane rails.

faq.q: How big was the Raiwind crane shed?
faq.a: The crane shed covers 96,600 square feet, and the crane and mezzanine shed covers 97,888 square feet.

faq.q: Can the shed carry two cranes?
faq.a: Yes, if the design includes both from the start.

blocks.text: A crane shed is a steel building with overhead cranes running on rails along its length. Factories use them to move steel, machine parts, containers or finished goods. The whole structure is designed around the crane loads.

Steel Mind Engineers built a pre-engineered crane shed of 96,600 square feet at Raiwind for Haier, 30 feet high, 184 feet wide and 525 feet long. It also built a PEB crane and mezzanine shed of 97,888 square feet, 33 feet high, 184 feet wide and 532 feet long. These projects show the scale Steel Mind Engineers can handle. Watch the project film on the Home page.

Crane capacity, span, lifting height and duty cycle set the size of columns and runway beams. Rails must be level and straight within tight limits, and the factory cuts and drills them to drawing. Crane columns carry large loads, so the foundation is designed with the steel. Crane stops, access ladders and walkways are placed in the design.
Read the Crane System page for technical detail and the Crane Gantry Structures page for outdoor cranes.
